submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1 only: a single native 1254 x 1254 transparent RGBA game sprite, 天音少女 NW run frame 10. Image 1 is the edit target and exact composition; image 2 is a same-character NW motion-plane reference only, do not copy its different pose; image 3 is the approved hand-painted material/style reference only, do not add UI. Keep the original frame's body, head, hair, ribbons, face, hands, qin, camera, character size, full framing, hips, knees, support-leg pose and boot contact exactly unchanged. Maintain anatomical LEFT hand on upper qin and RIGHT hand at lower strings. The anatomical LEFT foot remains the grounded support foot; RIGHT is the raised rear recovery foot.
LOCAL CORRECTION ONLY: the raised rear RIGHT boot currently has a broad sole facing the camera with an almost vertical or screen-right tilted sole long axis, twisting sideways relative to its NW-directed knee and shin. Correct only this raised ankle and boot orientation. Keep its existing ankle location and raised heel/rear-knee flexion, but align the boot in the same forward-back NW sagittal plane as the bent lower leg. A relaxed toe points obliquely down and toward screen LEFT from the ankle, never outward to screen right. Show a naturally foreshortened oblique side-and-sole view with the heel/toe axis following that diagonal motion plane, not a full flat sole plate facing the camera. Sole visibility from knee flexion is allowed and should remain physically natural. Preserve gold embroidery, purple sole, ivory leather and boot proportions. Do not relocate the foot to the front, do not change which leg supports, do not straighten the bent knee, do not replace the body with image 2. Exactly one character, exact 1254-square original canvas and scale, transparent background, no floor/shadow/text. Do not rotate or reposition the entire character.
